context: Placing the terminal's real cursor on a text input inside a centered panel

checklist.name: real_cursor_from_input
checklist.description: Turns off the input's simulated cursor with `SetVirtualCursor(false)` and takes `Cursor()` from the input on each render, assigning it to the `Cursor` field of the returned `tea.View`; does not leave the input drawing its own cursor.

checklist.name: cursor_offset
checklist.description: Offsets the cursor by the input's position on screen: the panel's centering offset plus its border and padding and any lines above the input inside the panel, so the cursor lands on the typed character rather than at the panel's top left or the window origin.

checklist.name: cursor_hidden_when_blurred
checklist.description: Leaves the view's `Cursor` nil when the input is not focused, so no terminal cursor shows while the button has focus.

checklist.name: focus_cmd
checklist.description: Returns the command from the input's `Focus()` (from `Init` and when tab returns focus) and calls `Blur()` when focus leaves.

checklist.name: result_after_run
checklist.description: Prints the entered name after `Run` returns, from the final model, not from inside `Update` or `View`.

checklist.name: alt_screen_field
checklist.description: Enables the alternate screen with `AltScreen = true` on the returned `tea.View`.
